description: This file contains Sass/SCSS functions, mixins, keyframes, media queries, and a utility for CSS. It provides helper functions for mathematical operations, transition and animation mixins, keyframe animations, media query helpers, and a clearfix utility, all aimed at facilitating CSS styling in the project.

methods.name: exponent
methods.description: Calculates exponentiation of a base raised to an exponent, supporting positive and negative integer exponents.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Alias for the exponent function, providing a shorthand for power calculations.
